/* CastMapMapper.retrieveMapRsltList */
SELECT #{hhmm} AS TIME, B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD, CASE WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('CC', 'CK', 'SBD') THEN SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, -3, 1) WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('LGT') THEN SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, 4, 1) WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('SC', 'SR') THEN SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, 5, 1) ELSE ' ' END AS UNIT_CD, NVL(MAX(A.WTNG_PSG_CNT), 0) AS WTNG_PSG_CNT, NVL(SUM(A.TRNST_PSG_CNT), 0) AS TRNST_PSG_CNT, NVL(ROUND(AVG(A.AVG_WTNG_HR)), 0) AS WTNG_HR, NVL(ROUND(AVG(A.AVG_PRCS_HR)), 0) AS PRCS_HR FROM PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_RSLT_DTL A INNER JOIN PMOWN.TN_PM_SMLT_PSG_FCLT B ON A.PSG_FCLT_CD = B.PSG_FCLT_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.SMLT_ID = #{smltId} AND B.TMNL_ID = #{tmnlId} AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN (#{item}) AND TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 'HH24') = SUBSTR(#{hhmm}, 1, 2) -- 30분 버킷: 앞 30분(00~29) 과 뒤 30분(30~59) 을 나눈다 AND FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(A.SMLT_ACTL_DT, 'MI')) / 30) = FLOOR(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(#{hhmm}, 3, 2)) / 30) GROUP BY B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD, CASE WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('CC', 'CK', 'SBD') THEN SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, -3, 1) WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('LGT') THEN SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, 4, 1) WHEN B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD IN ('SC', 'SR') THEN SUBSTR(B.PSG_FCLT_CD, 5, 1) ELSE ' ' END ORDER BY B.UP_PSG_FCLT_CD, UNIT_CD
